      "section": "tome-cults/data/lore/zones.lua",
      "source": "There have often been reports among our brethren about the presence of a magical aberration near the foot of the dwarven mountains. Until today, we have not been able to trace its source. I had suspected that we would come across the foul abode of a necromancer or maybe some other form of arcane wielder... But what we found was an abomination unlike any I have seen before.\n\nAs we approached the crag, you could practically smell the blight in the air. What little sunlight entered the crag illuminated... something. All I could see was a vast lump of tentacles, writhing and squirming over each other. What I saw next both filled me with disgust and melancholy. The proud form of a drake stood among the mass, but where its head should have been only appeared a mass of tendrils. Its very skin seemed to contain the wriggling mass of some monstrosity. One of nature's proudest creatures, transformed into something which perverted all that is natural and good in this world.\n\nMy first instinct was to lead a charge into the crag and cleanse this terrible place, but I knew this would be a mistake. It will pain all of us deeply to not take action now, but there is no sense in throwing our lives away. For now, we must establish camp and observe this threat.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "我们的弟兄中经常有人报告，矮人山脚附近出现了某种魔法畸变。在今天之前，我们一直没能追查到它的源头。我原以为我们会碰上某个死灵法师的邪恶巢穴，或是某种奥术使用者……但我们发现的却是我前所未见的可憎之物。\n\n当我们走近岩谷时，立刻就能闻到空气中枯萎的气息。微弱的阳光射入了岩谷，照亮了……某种东西。我眼前看到的是一大团触须，不断扭动，互相缠卷。接下来在我眼前展现出的一切，让我的心中既充满厌恶，又满怀悲凉。一头巨龙傲然挺立在那团触须之中，但它本该是头部的地方却只有一团卷须。它的皮肤之下仿佛裹着某种怪物蠕动的肉团。这头巨龙本是大自然最骄傲的生灵之一，却被扭曲成了亵渎世间一切自然与美好的怪物。\n\n我的第一反应是率众冲进岩谷，净化这个可怕的地方，但我知道那样做是个错误。此刻按兵不动会让我们所有人深感痛心，但白白送命毫无意义。现在，我们必须建立营地，观察这一威胁。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "cults",
      "entry_id": "e160a13d1bedd8001f7616b1c3dec37f5decae8f76926a9f949a3afe2cd7603e",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0409 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "tome-cults/data/lore/zones.lua",
      "source": "Some puzzle this is! I finally enter the right combination and it dumps me in some forsaken corner of the world! I don't even know what to make of my surroundings, they're utterly bizarre! Why did this have to happen to me? I was supposed to be the one who got in first and got the treasure... Now look at me! I've wandered all over this place, but I can't find any exit! It's like this entire place is conspiring to keep me trapped here!",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "这是什么鬼谜题！我好不容易输入了正确的组合，结果它竟把我扔到一个被世界遗忘的角落！我甚至搞不清周围是什么地方，这里的环境实在太怪异了！为什么我要倒这种霉！我本该是第一个闯进去、拿到宝藏的人…现在呢？我在这里到处游荡，结果连出口都找不到！这个地方简直就是为了困死我而设计出来的！"
    }
  ],
